FIXED_MODE_RULE=Do not invent a target from fixed_notional. Until durable Build3 UI/config/product evidence proves the intended target model, any fixed-mode wallet must produce no order and surface FIXED_MODE_AUTHORITY_HOLD. Proportional mode may continue through G2. G2 may PASS with fixed mode held only if this fail-closed behaviour is executed/proven and the unresolved fixed-mode product requirement is carried explicitly into G4; project DONE still requires fixed mode to be resolved and proven before final certification.

EVENT_LINEAGE_PERSISTENCE=ALLOWED_WITH_RULES
EVENT_LINEAGE_RULES=leader_event_positions may be persisted only inside the existing SERVICE_STATE_FILE; no new file/database/store. It is a checkpoint of authority already created by genuine post-baseline leader events, never an independent source of new authority. Mutation is permitted only from one eligibility-passed, deduplicated genuine leader event and must be durably coupled to that event's processed identity/high-water. Restart may reload the checkpoint to preserve previously-created authority. Restart, snapshot, current leader position, follower truth, or reconciliation must never seed, top-up, rewrite, or infer lineage. If the checkpoint is missing, corrupt, stale, or inconsistent with the processed-event ledger, fail closed with zero order authority until deterministic replay of durable genuine events reconstructs it. Snapshot may detect divergence only.

INVARIANT_AMENDMENT=Invariant 4/no-new-authoritative-persistent-store remains intact: this ruling allows a new field in the EXISTING service-state store as a durability checkpoint of already-authorised event lineage; it does not authorise a new persistence subsystem or snapshot-derived authority. PRODUCT_SEMANTICS open-items/control state should record the temporary fixed-mode hold and this checkpoint rule.

G2_CORRECTION_AUTHORISED=YES
G2_IMPLEMENTATION_CORRECTIONS_REQUIRED=1) replace wallet-local dry-run actual_net with account-net follower exposure semantics; where authoritative live account-net truth is not yet available in G2, fail closed rather than treat wallet-local state as truth, leaving full exchange-truth plumbing to G3; 2) preserve and execute planner order.side exactly; do not derive send direction from leader event side; 3) wire existing in-flight exposure into convergence/effective-actual so duplicate or overlapping sends cannot be authorised; no new persistent store; 4) retain exactly one physical order call site.

SCOPE=Correct the failed G2 commit only. No G3 multi-DEX/restart-settlement expansion and no G4 UI/lifecycle work. Remain within <=2 production files and <=260 genuinely new production LOC from the frozen baseline; if correction exceeds the tripwire, escalate before proceeding.

G2_ACCEPTANCE=Controller must re-review the corrected exact commit and executed tests proving proportional repeated ADD/reduce/close/opposite-direction behaviour, account-net convergence semantics, planner side preservation, in-flight suppression, duplicate-event exactly-once, restart checkpoint rehydration without snapshot-created authority, fixed-mode fail-closed HOLD, one order call site, scope budget, and refreshed Graphify.

NEXT_ACTION=Controller issue exactly this G2 correction to Hermes. On corrected G2 PASS, wake Architect before G3.
